$comment: The pinned authority every selfhost oracle is stamped from: rederive's own cli/ (+ LICENSE) at this commit, extracted by stamp.mjs into .authority/<commit>/ with git archive and refused unless its tree hash matches. Later edits to cli/ cannot move an oracle. A fix to the kernel is a NEW authority (a new commit here) and a re-stamp, never an edit of an oracle.
